mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.GR_CD , t1.SEBU_CD AS tr_co_cd , t2.TR_CO_NM AS xx_tr_co_cd , t1.SEBU_CD_NM AS susu_tr_co_cd , t3.TR_CO_NM AS xx_susu_tr_co_cd , t1.SEBU_CD_EFNM AS susu_tr_co_cd1 , t4.TR_CO_NM AS xx_susu_tr_co_cd1 , 1 AS p_visible FROM SZX1GR t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX2MM t3 ON t3.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t3.TR_CO_CD = t1.SEBU_CD_NM LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX2MM t4 ON t4.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t4.TR_CO_CD = t1.SEBU_CD_EFNM JOIN SZX2MM t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.TR_CO_CD = t1.SEBU_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.GR_CD = 'PP' ORDER BY t1.SEBU_CD

SELECT DISTINCT t1.TR_CO_CD AS tr_co_cd , mm.TR_CO_NM AS xx_tr_co_cd , 'PP' AS gr_cd , 1 AS p_visible FROM SSM0KM t1 JOIN SZX0AA t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.HYUN_YMD = t1.YMD JOIN SSX0KJ t3 ON t3.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t3.SJ_CD = t1.SJ_CD AND t3.LSY_YMD BETWEEN TRUNC(t2.HYUN_YMD, 'MM') AND LAST_DAY(t2.HYUN_YMD) JOIN SZX2MM mm ON mm.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND mm.TR_CO_CD = t1.TR_CO_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.TR_CO_CD
